title: Relay views
brief: Every view of Relay on Bolt cobalt: main window with the environment dropdown, workspace settings, request editor tabs, response states, collection settings, command palette, welcome, Postman import and agent approval.

artboards.title: Main window, environment dropdown
artboards.tradeoff: Environments only in the title bar; the sidebar is collections only

artboards.title: Workspace settings: environments
artboards.tradeoff: Shared and current values side by side; a modal keeps context but limits width

artboards.title: Request body: form data
artboards.tradeoff: Segmented body modes; file parts as chips

artboards.title: Request auth
artboards.tradeoff: Inheritance shown explicitly; the long auth type list needs grouping

artboards.title: Response headers and sending
artboards.tradeoff: Cancel replaces Send while in flight

artboards.title: Response error and timeline
artboards.tradeoff: Exact transport error text; timeline from a previous send

artboards.title: Collection settings
artboards.tradeoff: One document with sections; scripts edited in place

artboards.title: Command palette
artboards.tradeoff: Everything reachable by keyboard; grouped results

artboards.title: Agent approval
artboards.tradeoff: Human-only approval with the resolved target
